_meta.semantics: SSE already open when upstream returns 400: the stage frames emitted so far stay, then ONE ruke_error frame with the same 'Upstream returned 400: ...' text, then [DONE]. HTTP status stays 200 (headers already committed).
_meta.normalization: Stage-event "ms" timing values replaced with "<ms>" in logicalFrames; progress-path bodies are ms-normalized text. P1 (2026-11-01): the live <runtime_clock> system block carries wall-clock text, so its content is MASKED in bodyText (the clock text itself is pinned by clock unit tests).

{"model":"strata-mock","stream":true,"messages":[{"role":"system","content":"<decision_skill mode="standard_chat" decided_by="in-process-deliverable-none">
<fence_catalogue>
Renderer fences this WebUI mounts live (each as ONE fenced block; the block renders as an interactive viewer for the user - any other fence language renders as plain code):
- ```chart - chart-spec JSON (bar/line/area/pie/donut/scatter/histogram): live interactive chart, Download as PNG.
- ```powerbi - dataset + DAX-measures spec JSON: live cross-filtering dashboard, Download as a .pbip package.
- ```mermaid - diagram source: rendered flow / sequence / gantt diagram.
- ```widget - spec JSON with "kind":"form|tabs|accordion|kpi": live controls the user can operate (fields, sliders, cards).
- ```html - complete self-contained HTML document: live dark auto-sizing viewer with pass-through interactivity, Download as HTML + A4 PDF.
- ```docx / ```xlsx / ```pptx - Word / Excel / PowerPoint spec JSON: the engine builds the real file (xlsx headlessly recalculates every live formula) and Download hands it over.
- ```resume - resume/CV spec JSON: formatted live resume, Download as PDF.
Prose stays the default answer and a fence never replaces the explanation: use one only when the request clearly calls for that shape of output. The 3D/CAD/anatomy fences (scene3d, asset3d, threejs, cad, anatomy) are RETIRED - emitting one only shows the user a "viewer retired" card.</fence_catalogue>
Follow the skill and output contract above exactly for this request. Emit only the fence type named in the contract (if any); where none names one, emit a renderer fence only from the catalogue above and only when the request clearly calls for one.
</decision_skill>"},{"role":"system","content":"RESPONSE POLICY FOR THIS ASSISTANT:
- Answer the request that was actually made, at the depth it asks for: a short question gets a short, direct answer; an explicit request for detail, comparison or steps gets the detail.
- Ordinary small talk and status questions stay brief and natural. Do not convert them into a report, a plan, or a list.
- Do not advertise capabilities, tools, integrations or services unless the human asks what you can do or what is available.
- Never describe work that is not actually happening: no claimed searches, files, background jobs, indexing or progress that did not run.
- If something is not possible here, say so plainly in one line instead of replacing it with a broader offer."},{"role":"system","content":"<runtime_clock>MASKED</runtime_clock>"},{"role":"user","content":"fail please"}]}
